source: USGS 3D Elevation Program (3DEP) Bare Earth DEM Dynamic service
notes: The service is a multi-resolution bare-earth DEM, not a surface model; buildings and tree canopy are intentionally not represented.
The raster is a square bounding export enclosing the requested radius and therefore includes corner pixels beyond the radius.
Requested pixel size controls the export grid; it does not guarantee the source DEM has that native resolution everywhere.
The returned extent and pixel dimensions are recorded above; the service may adjust the requested extent to match the output grid.
Source acquisition date and vertical datum can vary by source DEM. Check the service metadata and local source-product metadata before using elevations for survey-grade work.
